about: The priest says the Confíteor first, bowed low. He addresses the ministers with “vobis, fratres” and “vos, fratres”. They then make their own confession, saying “tibi, pater” and “te, pater” where he said “vobis, fratres” and “vos, fratres”.

seg.nr: The priest joins his hands, bows deeply, and recites the Confíteor.

seg.tr: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, to all the Saints, and to you, brethren:

fn.w001: Governs the chain of datives that follows.
fn.w006: Together with “Vírgini” (w007), forms the title “ever Virgin”.
fn.w008: Agrees with the name that follows, “Michaéli” (w009).
fn.w022: Dative plural, the final complement of “Confíteor” (w001).
fn.w023: Vocative plural used in direct address.

seg.tr: that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed:

fn.w024: Introduces the clause “quia peccávi”, which states what is confessed.
fn.w027: The first of three ablatives of means: by thought, word, and deed.

seg.nr: The priest strikes his breast three times.

seg.tr: through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault.

Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, all the Saints, and you, brethren, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

fn.w038: Links the confession to the request for intercession that follows.
fn.w039: Takes an accusative of the person and an infinitive: to beseech someone to do something.
fn.w043: Compare “Vírgini” (w007) — the same formula, there in the dative.
fn.w058: Accusative object of “precor” (w039). Compare the dative “vobis” (w022).
fn.w060: Infinitive completing “precor” (w039): to beseech someone to pray.
